existingMitigationsGroundedInSource: Ticket validity: scope, epoch, stack, owner lifetime, owner node connected, dialog open (createDialogFocusScope.valid); captured only when an owner exists and the origin's dialog is the owner (capture).
Owned window: focus.run increments owned so the recovery's own focus event does not bump the epoch, while later events still expire it.

Eligibility checks before any focus or scroll: isConnected, inside dialog, not :disabled, not inside [inert], not input.sr-only, has client rects, visibility visible (installDialogVisibility.eligible; DialogFeedback.tsx:84-86; SavedDataDialog.tsx:118-123).

Observer discipline: ResizeObserver and MutationObserver callbacks only schedule a frame; the dialog's own style mutations are filtered; size() avoids clientHeight to prevent self-shrinking; flow mode latches until the geometry basis or footer text changes.

Lifetime ownership: isOwner() requires live, connected, open, current owner dialog and matching lifetime; cleanup disconnects observers, removes listeners, cancels frames and restores only still-published values (dialog-visibility.ts cleanup ending at 742).
Dialog effect ordering: install after showModal, stopVisibility before unregister and close (ui.tsx:56-85); keepTab trap unchanged (60-79).
Deferred opener reveal cancels on wheel, touch, pointer, key or focus and re-checks owner lifetime, no open dialog, connection and visibility (revealRestoredOpener).
Unchanged import limits: 50 MiB pre-read size gate, byte re-check, JSON.parse failure mapped to a format error, MAX_IMPORT_RECORDS 5000 (shared/saved-backup.ts).
staleOrDetachedDomHandling: currentOwner filters hosts by node.isConnected and dialog.open from a synchronous registry (DialogFeedback.tsx:28-33), so a closed or unmounted dialog cannot own focus.
SavedFeedback discards the pending request when the ticket is invalid, when another element took focus, or when the button is still usable (DialogFeedback.tsx:107-116).

SavedDataDialog restoration refuses detached, foreign-dialog, disabled, inert, invisible or zero-size destinations and verifies the trigger still maps to the same source that still exists in storage.recovery (119-128); refs cleared on removal end and unmount (108-110, 138-141); recoveryTriggers is a WeakMap keyed by buttons.
Helper generation counters (invalidate, engage) retire deferred work from superseded contexts; a cleaned-up controller never writes (live flag).
Minor retention only: the last focused element, ticket origin/owner references in state, and the observed Set live until replaced or cleanup; bounded, not a leak path in the code read.
unverifiedOrUnmeasured: Performance and lifecycle: a subtree MutationObserver with characterData, ResizeObserver on dialog, direct children and the focused proxy, per-keystroke engage() microtasks with layout reads, and size() running querySelectorAll(READERS) plus getComputedStyle per matched element (up to about three readers per row times PAGE_SIZE 20 in the backup dialog). Cost is unmeasured; no freeze or jank claim is made or excluded.
Convergence of the flow/sticky footer mode and the scheduling loop is argued from source (latching basis, filtered mutations, one coalesced follow-up frame) but not executed.

Browser API assumptions: ResizeObserver, document.fonts (unconditional addEventListener), Array.prototype.at, scrollTo with behavior 'instant', visualViewport (optional-chained), CSS.escape (pre-existing). No error boundary exists in src (grep), so an install-time exception inside Dialog's layout effect would propagate to the root. Robustness, not security; not observed.
StrictMode is on (src/main.tsx:9). listen() throws on a second attach without cleanup; React's effect cleanup-then-rerun satisfies this by design, but it was not executed here.
Root HEAD identity and byte-equality of root files to the snapshots rest on the manifest, the baseline record and content markers, since the helper cannot hash root paths.
